content.comment_body: Does anyone know what the resolution is for the onboard analogue inputs of the [product_name] [version_no]? I can find that the [product_name] expansion module has a 10-bit resolution, normalized to 0 to 1000. I assume the onboard analogue inputs offer similar specs but haven't found confirmation in any [document]. Any help would be appreciated.
All analogue inputs feature a 10-bit resolution, normalized from 0 to 1000.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is asking for confirmation on the resolution of onboard analogue inputs for a [product_name] module and compares it to the known specification of an expansion module. The key concern is the absence of clear documentation for onboard inputs, making system design and configuration challenging for users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects comprehensive documentation that clearly states the resolution for both onboard and expansion analogue inputs.
